name: food-ordering-platform
description: Cloud-native, event-driven food ordering platform (microservices monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @food/common && npm run build -ws --if-present --include-workspace-root=false
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @food/common && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @food/common && npm run test -ws --if-present && node scripts/openapi.mjs check
